#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduce asmlift on `_MtxF_to_Mtx` — benchmark function af:_MtxF_to_Mtx:ido7.1.
set -euo pipefail

# asmlift checkout — run `pnpm install` there once, with this function's toolchain available
# (`pnpm bench setup` fetches bench-owned toolchains + pinned project checkouts;
# apps/benchmark/README lists the env-var overrides; .github/workflows/benchmark.yml shows a
# complete from-scratch setup):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

# This function's decomp project — the PINNED benchmark branch (provenance base + one
# integration commit). Not needed to run this script (inputs are embedded/vendored); to
# rebuild the project itself:
#   git clone --branch asmlift-benchmark https://github.com/macabeus/af.git af
#   make -C af
#   make -C af asmlift-elf   # derive the symbols ELF (DWARF types-sidecar)
# SYMBOLS: this row ran WITH the project's symbol map (names + declaration shapes derived
# from the ELF its decomp.yaml names), vendored at apps/benchmark/dataset/real/tu/af/symbols.json.gz
#   sha256 of the decompressed map JSON: 1c10afb05850b76cba9adbe53c6515245f0e8b5a27e0fd4c0f718a25a99f9dfb
# Set PROJECT_PATH to your BUILT checkout of the project above (clone recipe in the comments);
# step 1 then points the scoring config at the checkout's decomp.yaml (tools.asmlift.elf) —
# the CLI loads the same map, so this run reproduces the row's named spellings. A missing
# checkout/ELF warns and runs map-less (output may then differ from the row).
PROJECT_PATH='/path/to/af'

# ── Step 1: scoring inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Builds this function's target object (content-cached) and writes a decomp.yaml whose compile
# command is the benchmark's own toolchain invocation — what --score-against compiles with.
# --project-root grafts the checkout's tools.asmlift.elf (the symbol map) into that decomp.yaml.
# (progress goes to stderr so the script's stdout stays purely the decompiled source)
pnpm --dir "$ASMLIFT_PATH" bench target af:_MtxF_to_Mtx:ido7.1 --out "$PWD" --project-root "$PROJECT_PATH" 1>&2

    lh	$v1, 2($a1)

PROJECT_PATH='/path/to/klonoa-empire-of-dreams'

scripts.asmlift:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduce asmlift on `VBlankDMA_Level2` — benchmark function kleod:VBlankDMA_Level2:agbcc.
set -euo pipefail

# asmlift checkout — run `pnpm install` there once, with this function's toolchain available
# (`pnpm bench setup` fetches bench-owned toolchains + pinned project checkouts;
# apps/benchmark/README lists the env-var overrides; .github/workflows/benchmark.yml shows a
# complete from-scratch setup):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

# This function's decomp project — the PINNED benchmark branch (provenance base + one
# integration commit). Not needed to run this script (inputs are embedded/vendored); to
# rebuild the project itself:
#   git clone --branch asmlift-benchmark https://github.com/Dream-Atelier/kl-eod-decomp.git klonoa-empire-of-dreams
#   make -C klonoa-empire-of-dreams
# SYMBOLS: this row ran WITH the project's symbol map (names + declaration shapes derived
# from the ELF its decomp.yaml names), vendored at apps/benchmark/dataset/real/tu/kleod/symbols.json.gz
#   sha256 of the decompressed map JSON: 64724e9812cc973d94eb48c08bf3eeaef39798744d75677004e524d908c44c5c
# Set PROJECT_PATH to your BUILT checkout of the project above (clone recipe in the comments);
# step 1 then points the scoring config at the checkout's decomp.yaml (tools.asmlift.elf) —
# the CLI loads the same map, so this run reproduces the row's named spellings. A missing
# checkout/ELF warns and runs map-less (output may then differ from the row).
PROJECT_PATH='/path/to/klonoa-empire-of-dreams'

# ── Step 1: scoring inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Builds this function's target object (content-cached) and writes a decomp.yaml whose compile
# command is the benchmark's own toolchain invocation — what --score-against compiles with.
# --project-root grafts the checkout's tools.asmlift.elf (the symbol map) into that decomp.yaml.
# (progress goes to stderr so the script's stdout stays purely the decompiled source)
pnpm --dir "$ASMLIFT_PATH" bench target kleod:VBlankDMA_Level2:agbcc --out "$PWD" --project-root "$PROJECT_PATH" 1>&2

# apps/benchmark/README lists the env-var overrides; .github/workflows/benchmark.yml shows a
# complete from-scratch setup):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

# integration commit). Not needed to run this script (inputs are embedded/vendored); to

PROJECT_PATH='/path/to/sa3'

# (real tier: candidates are scored INSIDE the project's own context — step 1 materializes the
# row's vendored context next to target.o as ctx.i, and the generated decomp.yaml concatenates

  --no-cache              # bypass m2c's on-disk cache — always a fresh run

python3 "$M2C_PATH/m2c.py" "${args[@]}" in.s

	.align	2, 0
	.globl	zxparam
	.type	 zxparam,function
	.thumb_func
zxparam:
	push	{r4, lr}
	lsl	r0, r0, #0x18
	lsr	r0, r0, #0x18
	lsl	r1, r1, #0x18
	lsr	r1, r1, #0x18
	mov	r4, #0x1
	add	r3, r0, #0
	and	r3, r3, r4
	str	r3, [r2]
	add	r3, r1, #0
	and	r3, r3, r4
	str	r3, [r2, #0x4]
	add	r0, r0, r1
	str	r0, [r2, #0x8]
	pop	{r4}
	pop	{r0}
	bx	r0
.Lfe1:
	.size	 zxparam,.Lfe1-zxparam
ASM_INPUT

# The exact context header the benchmark passed via --context.
# Prototypes only — no struct or global layouts. The synthetic tier measures COLD recovery and is
# symmetric by construction: these are the same facts asmlift is given as --proto hints, and
# neither tool is given a project.
cat > ctx.h <<'CTX_INPUT'
void zxparam(u8 a, u8 b, s32 *out);
CTX_INPUT

args=(
  --target gba            # ISA + compiler dialect (selects m2c's code-shape assumptions)
  --function zxparam      # the symbol to decompile from in.s
  --context ctx.h         # the prototype header written above
  --no-cache              # bypass m2c's on-disk cache — always a fresh run
)
python3 "$M2C_PATH/m2c.py" "${args[@]}" in.s
scripts.asmlift:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduce asmlift on `zxparam` — benchmark function synthetic:zxparam:agbcc.
set -euo pipefail

# asmlift checkout — run `pnpm install` there once, with this function's toolchain available
# (`pnpm bench setup` fetches bench-owned toolchains + pinned project checkouts;
# apps/benchmark/README lists the env-var overrides; .github/workflows/benchmark.yml shows a
# complete from-scratch setup):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

# ── Step 1: scoring inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Builds this function's target object (content-cached) and writes a decomp.yaml whose compile
# command is the benchmark's own toolchain invocation — what --score-against compiles with.
# (progress goes to stderr so the script's stdout stays purely the decompiled source)
pnpm --dir "$ASMLIFT_PATH" bench target synthetic:zxparam:agbcc --out "$PWD" 1>&2

# ── Step 2: the input the benchmark fed asmlift, verbatim ────────────────────
# The exact agbcc `.s` text.
cat > in.asm <<'ASM_INPUT'
@ Generated by gcc 2.9-arm-000512 for Thumb/elf
	.code	16
.gcc2_compiled.:
.text
	.align	2, 0
	.globl	zxparam
	.type	 zxparam,function
	.thumb_func
zxparam:
	push	{r4, lr}
	lsl	r0, r0, #0x18
	lsr	r0, r0, #0x18
	lsl	r1, r1, #0x18
	lsr	r1, r1, #0x18
	mov	r4, #0x1
	add	r3, r0, #0
	and	r3, r3, r4
	str	r3, [r2]
	add	r3, r1, #0
	and	r3, r3, r4
	str	r3, [r2, #0x4]
	add	r0, r0, r1
	str	r0, [r2, #0x8]
	pop	{r4}
	pop	{r0}
	bx	r0
.Lfe1:
	.size	 zxparam,.Lfe1-zxparam
ASM_INPUT

# The prototype hints the benchmark fed asmlift (callee arities / void-ness).
cat > proto.json <<'PROTO_INPUT'
{
  "zxparam": {
    "params": [
      "u8",
      "u8",
      "s32 *"
    ],
    "returnsVoid": true
  }
}
PROTO_INPUT

# ── Step 3: decompile + benchmark-grade scoring ──────────────────────────────
args=(
  in.asm                  # input: the disassembly text above
  --target agbcc          # frontend + target description (ISA, calling convention, compiler idioms)
  --name zxparam          # the symbol to decompile (multi-function input selects by name)
  --proto proto.json      # the prototype hints above (callee arities / void-ness)
  --config decomp.yaml    # the compile command from step 1
  --score-against target.o # rank candidate variants, objdiff-score each; exit 0 only on byte-exact
)
# the checkout's own asmlift bin (pnpm links it; it runs through the repo's pinned tsx)
"$ASMLIFT_PATH/node_modules/.bin/asmlift" "${args[@]}"
